oliver: Dropping a short follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A re: hybrid / travel / offsite questions. Will collect answers here and link the one-pager.

anika: Quick Qs: 1) If I want to work from another US city for 10 days (workation), what form and lead time? 2) Can I bring my partner to a team dinner at a regional offsite?

director-people: Short answers: 1) File the Remote Location Request 72 hours before departure for domestic trips under 14 days; approvals are routine. Cross-border requires legal + finance review. 2) Partners ok for small regional socials (manager opt-in, usually self-pay). Not allowed for customer retreats or strategy offsites.

ben: Expense nit: receipts for meals vs per diem? Example to copy into Concur?

director-people: Use receipts for flights, hotels, rides. Domestic offsite per diem $65/day for meals. Concur snippet you can copy:

```
Expense Type: Meals
Amount: 65
Date: 2026-08-12
Notes: Team offsite - regional hub
Receipt: attached (if > per diem)
```

people-ops-bot: Travel & Remote Location FAQ uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/policies/travel_remote_faq (edited)

oliver: Any guidance on coworking stipends vs day-pass reimbursements? I travel a lot and it’d be handy.

director-people: Opt-in coworking stipend = $150/month. For ad-hoc trips, submit day-pass receipts up to $30/day under "Travel - Other." If coworking is frequent while traveling, opt into the stipend.

anika: Hoteling conflicts at HQ still happening. Interim fix?

director-people: New hoteling system goes live next sprint. Interim priority: meeting organizer > recurring desk owner > one-off hoteling. If you see a double-book, post screenshot to #desk-ops and ops will reconcile.

ceo: Leadership reminder: for any visits to dedicated or private infra sites, request visitor access at least 72 hours in advance. No same-day approvals.

oliver: Thanks all. I’ll draft a one-pager (workation flowchart + guest rules + expense examples) and ping this channel for review. Volunteers to proofread?

anika: I can review coworking/lodging language.

ben: I’ll check expense examples.

people-ops-bot: Draft uploaded to all-hands follow-ups: https://intranet.redwood/allhands/aug-2026/offsite-faq (edited)

oliver: Closing thread for edits at 1779127200. DM for exceptions or edge cases.
